name: biodesigner
description: A biomimicry design assistant built on NASA PeTaL's BIDARA prompt. Desktop app: Next.js renderer, Express back-end, Electron shell.

scripts.//setup: One command from a fresh clone: install and build everything.
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:shell
scripts.//build: Order matters: the shell inlines back-end/dist at bundle time and serves front-end/out at runtime.
scripts.//dev:desktop: Third terminal. Loads the Next dev server in the window, so the renderer hot-reloads; the back-end runs in the shell, not on :4000.
scripts.start:desktop: npm run build && npm run start --workspace electron
scripts.//dev: Browser: two terminals, backend and renderer, and the renderer reads NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL to find the back-end. Desktop: renderer and desktop, with no server on :4000 at all.
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package --workspace electron
scripts.//package: The full chain, then the macOS .app/.dmg into electron/release/. Unsigned on purpose — see electron-builder.yml.
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace back-end && npm run typecheck --workspace front-end && npm run typecheck --workspace electron
scripts.//typecheck: Delegated rather than running `tsc -p` from here. The packages pin different TypeScript majors, and a root-level tsc is whichever version happened to hoist — which is none of them.
